question: Count distinct destination IPs receiving TCP flows after 2011-08-15 17:00:00 in CTU scenario 5 and after 2011-08-16 14:00:00 in scenario 7; use strict time boundaries.

data.question: Count distinct destination IPs receiving TCP flows after 2011-08-15 17:00:00 in CTU scenario 5 and after 2011-08-16 14:00:00 in scenario 7; use strict time boundaries.
data.sql:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dst_ip)
   FROM network_flows
   WHERE source_dataset = 'ctu13_s5'
     AND protocol = 'TCP'
     AND dst_ip IS NOT NULL
     AND event_time > TIMESTAMP '2011-08-15 17:00:00') AS s5_distinct_dst_ip_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dst_ip)
   FROM network_flows
   WHERE source_dataset = 'ctu13_s7'
     AND protocol = 'TCP'
     AND dst_ip IS NOT NULL
     AND event_time > TIMESTAMP '2011-08-16 14:00:00') AS s7_distinct_dst_ip_count;

assessment_response.assessment: The count of distinct destination IPs receiving TCP flows after the specified strict time boundaries in CTU scenarios 5 and 7 has been determined.
